themes_detail.label: Illegal Dumping Surge
themes_detail.summary: Illegal dumping complaints spiked to 21 THIS WEEK, up 409% from the 4.1 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks, representing a sudden and severe environmental and public health issue in Greenwich Village/SoHo.
evidence: 21 illegal dumping complaints THIS WEEK vs. 4.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 9.21)
409% increase in complaints indicates sudden escalation, not gradual trend
Aligns with community board budget request for increased sanitation equipment and services
reporting_angles: Where is dumping occurring and why this week? Interview residents near hotspot locations.
Is this connected to reduced sanitation enforcement or staffing changes at DSNY?

themes_detail.label: Building Code Violations Spike
themes_detail.summary: Building/Use violations jumped to 17 complaints THIS WEEK, up 807% from 1.9 weekly average, signaling potential unsafe conditions or enforcement shifts in the district.
evidence: 17 Building/Use complaints THIS WEEK vs. 1.9 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 11.09)
807% spike indicates acute emerging issue, not chronic pattern
Community board repeatedly requests housing inspection programs—suggests existing capacity problem
reporting_angles: What specific violations are being reported? Interview DOB or HPD about enforcement activity.
Are complaints concentrated in particular buildings or neighborhoods within CD 102?

themes_detail.label: Dirty Conditions and Maintenance Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Dirty condition and maintenance complaints combined surged THIS WEEK—dirty condition at 23 complaints (up 183% from 8.1 avg) and maintenance at 27 complaints (up 260% from 7.5 avg)—suggesting deteriorating public space conditions.
evidence: Dirty Condition: 23 complaints THIS WEEK vs. 8.1 weekly average (z-score: 5.9, up 183%)
Maintenance or Facility: 27 complaints THIS WEEK vs. 7.5 weekly average (z-score: 4.36, up 260%)
Combined signal suggests systemic infrastructure neglect this week
reporting_angles: Are streets, parks, or subway infrastructure visibly deteriorating? Document conditions with photos.
Is this tied to weather, staffing shortages, or deferred maintenance cycles?

themes_detail.label: Panhandling Complaints Climb
themes_detail.summary: Panhandling complaints jumped to 7 THIS WEEK, up 250% from the 2.0 weekly average, marking a notable uptick in street-level encroachment complaints in the district.
evidence: 7 panhandling complaints THIS WEEK vs. 2.0 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 4.08, up 250%)
Timing suggests possible seasonal change or enforcement shift
Community board requests public health programs addressing homelessness/street activity
reporting_angles: Are residents reporting specific locations or individuals? Map complaint clusters.
Is this connected to warming weather bringing more street activity, or policy changes?

themes_detail.label: Graffiti and Vandalism Resurgence
themes_detail.summary: Graffiti complaints spiked to 45 TWO WEEKS AGO, up 368% from the 9.6 weekly average, indicating a notable but slightly older vandalism surge that warrants current investigation.
evidence: 45 graffiti complaints 2 WEEKS AGO vs. 9.6 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 5.86, up 368%)
Timing is 2 weeks old; check if complaints have subsided or continued at elevated levels
Community board requests Argus cameras (police surveillance), suggesting prior crime concerns
reporting_angles: Has the graffiti spike continued into this week, or has it subsided?
Are tags organized (gang-related) or random vandalism? Any pattern by location?
